name: typst
description: typst — markup-based typesetting system. Compile .typ files to PDF. Fast, modern alternative to LaTeX.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/typst/typst/releases/download/v0.13.1/typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz && tar xf typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz && sudo mv typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/typst /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo/pip install.

commands.description: typst — markup-based typesetting system. Compile .typ files to PDF. Fast, modern alternative to LaTeX.
